recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current source satisfies FHIR-16517 after later Observation refinements; adding the parenthetical fetus example to the short display would duplicate existing examples rather than change implementer understanding.
issue_request: FHIR-16517 was a Published/Persuasive OO clarification asking to distinguish the person or entity whose record contains the Observation from the actual focus, and to change the Observation.focus short display from the old focal-point wording to subject-of-record wording with a fetus-in-mother-record example.
initial_application: Historical commit 99532b4c0a6c05d7f6d3176df90ba33f1940abbc pre-applied GF#16517 in the Observation spreadsheet by replacing "The focal point of the observation" with "What the observation is about, when it is not about the subject of record." A later GF#16517 spreadsheet update carried that work forward before the current XML StructureDefinition became the authoritative source.
additional_context: Zulip and OO minutes confirm the intended model: Observation.subject is the record association and default focus when no separate focus is declared; Observation.focus captures another person, device, location, body structure, or other entity when the Observation is about something other than the subject. Later applied work for FHIR-29031 and FHIR-43357 refined the same Observation.subject and Observation.focus text and already has separate reconciliation commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml already gives Observation.focus the requested subject-of-record short display, defines focus as the actual focus when it is not the subject of record, and includes focus examples including a fetus in a mother's record. source/observation/observation-notes.xml also explains that subject is the record association and focus records the other entity when applicable.

related_jiras.note: Updated Observation.subject target wording after FHIR-16517 and already has its own reconciliation commit on the combined branch.
Refined Observation.focus examples for DeviceMetric-as-focus while retaining the FHIR-16517 subject-of-record model and already has its own reconciliation commit on the combined branch.
